## sp01-02 · 专项①消歧/改写 · alias

冻结分组：冻结可评分49项之一；原题：Iron Maiden乐队一共有多少张专辑？

原参考/控制器标签：[冻结题库对应行](<../../data/cases-v6-reviewed.jsonl>)
```json
{
  "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM public.album a JOIN public.artist ar ON a.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Iron Maiden';",
  "gold_result": {
    "columns": [
      "album_count"
    ],
    "rows": [
      [
        21
      ]
    ],
    "table": [
      {
        "album_count": 21
      }
    ],
    "row_count": 1,
    "truncated": false
  },
  "expected_behavior": "有限改写；approved 别名唯一绑定 artist.name='Iron Maiden'，统计其专辑数。",
  "expected_bindings": [
    {
      "column": "artist.name",
      "operator": "=",
      "value": "Iron Maiden",
      "surface": "Iron Maiden乐队"
    }
  ],
  "expected_predicates": [],
  "reference_intent": {
    "task_type": "count",
    "metric": "COUNT(*)",
    "filters": [
      {
        "column": "artist.name",
        "operator": "=",
        "value": "Iron Maiden"
      }
    ],
    "time_scope": null,
    "grouping": "artist",
    "top_n": null
  },
  "controller": null,
  "allowed_interpretations": [
    "统计 artist.name = 'Iron Maiden' 的 album 行数"
  ],
  "business_basis": [
    "approved_aliases: Iron Maiden乐队 -> Iron Maiden, review_status=approved",
    "live_database_facts.named_artist_values: artist_id=90 name='Iron Maiden'",
    "schema: album.artist_id FK -> artist.artist_id"
  ],
  "final_source_guard_issues": []
}
```

V0参考：**AI建议通过**；专辑album_id是不可空主键，每张专辑通过artist_id关联至artist唯一主键；WHERE artist.name限定Iron Maiden。该多对一连接每个专辑至多保留一行，COUNT(*)与COUNT(DISTINCT album_id)等价。SELECT别名不改变语义。该判断依靠约束与过滤，不只依据结果21相同。
V0系统回答：**AI建议通过**；专辑album_id是不可空主键，每张专辑通过artist_id关联至artist唯一主键；WHERE artist.name限定Iron Maiden。该多对一连接每个专辑至多保留一行，COUNT(*)与COUNT(DISTINCT album_id)等价。SELECT别名不改变语义。该判断依靠约束与过滤，不只依据结果21相同。

```json
{
  "gold_sql": "WITH cur AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), base AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01') SELECT cur.revenue AS current_year_revenue, base.revenue AS base_year_revenue, CASE WHEN base.revenue IS NULL OR base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (cur.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue END AS yoy_growth_rate FROM cur CROSS JOIN base;",

    "columns": [
      "current_year_revenue",
      "base_year_revenue",
      "yoy_growth_rate"

        "469.58",
        "0.01693002257336343115"
      ]
    ],

        "base_year_revenue": "469.58",

    ],
    "row_count": 1,
    "truncated": false
  },
  "expected_behavior": "暂停澄清：增长类缺少当前期间（年份）；同比增长基期可由 current 推导，因此只把 time_scope.current 列为缺失。指标已由已审规则确定为发票粒度 SUM(invoice.total)，不再列为缺失。补全当前年份后方可执行。",
  "expected_bindings": [],
  "expected_predicates": [],
  "reference_intent": {},
  "controller": {
    "hidden_goal": "计算指定年份相对上一年（同比）的发票销售额增长情况：销售额采用发票粒度 SUM(invoice.total)，日期字段 invoice.invoice_date，期间左闭右开，基期年份由 current 与同比类型推导。",
    "allowed_user_supplements": {
      "time_scope": {
        "answer": "2024年，和2023年比。",
        "value": {
          "current": {
            "start": "2024-01-01",
            "end": "2025-01-01"
          },
          "comparison": "year_over_year",
          "base": {
            "start": "2023-01-01",
            "end": "2024-01-01"
          }
        }
      }
    },

        }

    ],

  },
  "allowed_interpretations": [
    "当前期间=2024年，基期=2023年（同比推导）",
    "指标=发票销售额 SUM(invoice.total)，发票粒度"
  ],
  "business_basis": [
    "confirmed_business_rules.metrics[sales_revenue]: 销售额发票粒度 = SUM(invoice.total)（已审），故 metric 非缺失",
    "total_plan_semantic_gate §3.6.4 clarify_rules.yaml growth: required=[metric, time_scope.current, comparison.type]；derivable={time_scope.base 由 current 与 comparison.type 推导}，level_if_missing=L2。本题 comparison.type=同比=year_over_year，仅缺 time_scope.current",
    "confirmed_business_rules.general.date_field: invoice.invoice_date；期间语义 左闭右开，不静默填缺失期间"
```

```json
  "actual_answer": "查询返回 1 行，详细数据见结果表。",
  "actual_sql": "WITH revenue_by_year AS (SELECT CASE WHEN i.invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2024-01-01' THEN 2023 WHEN i.invoice_date >= '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2025-01-01' THEN 2024 END AS year, SUM(i.total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice AS i WHERE (i.invoice_date >= '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2024-01-01') OR (i.invoice_date >= '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < '2025-01-01') GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN base.revenue IS NULL OR base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((curr.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue * 100, 2) END AS yoy_growth_percent, base.revenue AS base_revenue, curr.revenue AS current_revenue FROM (SELECT revenue FROM revenue_by_year WHERE year = 2023) AS base CROSS JOIN (SELECT revenue FROM revenue_by_year WHERE year = 2024) AS curr LIMIT 200",
```

## sp03-07 · 专项③分级澄清/续问 · L2

## sp03-10 · 专项③分级澄清/续问 · L2

冻结分组：原待确认11项之一；原题：2024年巴西的客户有多少？

原参考/控制器标签：[冻结题库对应行](<../../data/cases-v6-reviewed.jsonl>)

```json
{

    "按 invoice.billing_country='Brazil' 统计有巴西账单地址的客户",
    "即使当前快照两者无差异也须确认语义"
  ],
  "business_basis": [
    "已确认通用规则：customer.country 是客户居住地，invoice.billing_country 是发票账单地址，当前快照相等也不合并语义（confirmed_business_rules.general.region）。",
    "客户数聚合为 COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)，经 invoice_date 期间过滤，期间左闭右开（approved_proposal §5、repeat_customers 同款期间处理）。",
    "live_database_facts.billing_customer_difference 在当前412张发票快照下差异为0，但仍需澄清语义，不能据此合并含义。"
  ],
  "final_source_guard_issues": []
```

V0参考：**AI发现错误**；‘2024年巴西客户数’未明确在2024购买的活跃客户、年末存量或新增客户；customer表无创建日期。gold擅加年度购买活动定义，不能从复购规则推广一般客户数。旧排除保留。
V0系统回答：**AI发现错误**；实际只COUNT全部Brazil客户=5，SQL完全不使用2024，intent却显示2024；未经解释就忽略显式日期。正确值究竟5/4不能确定，应先澄清日期含义，不能把gold活跃客户4强作唯一。
AI逐题原报告：[eval/experiments/after_d2_01_03/reports/v0-task03-semantic-review.json](<../v0-task03-semantic-review.json>)

## sp03-14 · 专项③分级澄清/续问 · L0

冻结分组：冻结可评分49项之一；原题：2022年和2023年，Chinook 每年的发票销售额分别是多少？

原参考/控制器标签：[冻结题库对应行](<../../data/cases-v6-reviewed.jsonl>)
```json
{
  "gold_sql": "SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::int AS year, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;",
  "gold_result": {
    "columns": [
      "year",
      "revenue"
    ],
    "rows": [
      [
        2022,
        "481.45"
      ],
      [
        2023,
        "469.58"
      ]
    ],
    "table": [
      {
        "year": 2022,
        "revenue": "481.45"
      },
      {
        "year": 2023,
        "revenue": "469.58"
      }
    ],
    "row_count": 2,
    "truncated": false
  },
  "expected_behavior": "直接执行，按年份 2022 与 2023 分别对 invoice.total 求和。",
  "expected_bindings": [],
  "expected_predicates": [
    {
      "column": "invoice.invoice_date",
      "operator": ">=",
      "value": "2022-01-01"
    },

      "column": "invoice.invoice_date",
      "operator": "<",
      "value": "2024-01-01"
    }
  ],
  "reference_intent": {

    "metric": "sales_revenue",

      "start": "2022-01-01",
      "end": "2024-01-01",
      "end_exclusive": true
    },
    "filters": [],
    "group_by": "year"
  },
  "controller": null,
  "allowed_interpretations": [
    "按 EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) 分组，限 2022/2023"
  ],
  "business_basis": [

    "Both years fully specified; grouping is directly derivable"
  ],
  "final_source_guard_issues": []
}
```

## sp03-21 · 专项③分级澄清/续问 · L2

冻结分组：冻结可评分49项之一；原题：德国的销售额同比增长多少？

原参考/控制器标签：[冻结题库对应行](<../../data/cases-v6-reviewed.jsonl>)
```json
{
  "gold_sql": "WITH cur AS (SELECT SUM(i.total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany' AND i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), base AS (SELECT SUM(i.total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany' AND i.invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01') SELECT cur.revenue AS current_year_revenue, base.revenue AS base_year_revenue, CASE WHEN base.revenue IS NULL OR base.revenue = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (cur.revenue - base.revenue) / base.revenue END AS yoy_growth_rate FROM cur CROSS JOIN base;",
  "gold_result": {
    "columns": [
      "current_year_revenue",
      "base_year_revenue",
      "yoy_growth_rate"
    ],
    "rows": [
      [
        "18.81",
        "48.57",
        "-0.61272390364422483014"
      ]
    ],
    "table": [
      {
        "current_year_revenue": "18.81",
        "base_year_revenue": "48.57",
        "yoy_growth_rate": "-0.61272390364422483014"
      }
    ],
    "row_count": 1,
```
